rules.multi_component: every component and connection visible together
rules.user_acceptance: pending, never inferred from agent review

gates.requirement: Reference-guided facial proportions and short dark bob with wispy bangs visibly continuous; actual exact identity is not claimed.
A wood-stocked period pistol and a connected visible lock with flint-gripping cock, frizzen and shallow pan are recognizable together. Generic pistol silhouette alone fails.
A glass bottle contains a visible miniature storm or lightning impossible under ordinary physical scale; blue light alone is insufficient.
Human attention, actual flintlock apparatus and working bottled magic share one intelligible workshop testing scene rather than separate decorative genre badges.
Two owned hands with plausible forearm reach; right rests behind lever, left steadies bottle support, with clear mechanism clearance.
A photographic person-centered scene preserves face presence while allocating enough visible pixels to the genre mechanisms.
